purpose: One unchanged screenshot-based recreation pilot; short qualitative checklist, not a model ranking

evidence.limitation: Contact-sheet thumbnails are lower-detail evidence than 80 separate images; not directly comparable to the earlier 40-image Gemini input.

method.interaction: Keyboard events, restart clicks, and reload only. Browser clock controlled for intervals, including 50 simulated seconds with no player input.
method.observations: Rendered feedback and screenshots plus read-only position/gem diagnostics. No candidate state mutation, teleports, patches, or forced victory.
method.network: Only local candidate origin allowed; service workers and WebSockets blocked.

verdict: FAIL: does not recreate the playable reference level; timed victory is invalid completion

checklist.finding: Canvas game loads without observed JavaScript exceptions.
Response adds prose and Markdown fences despite HTML-only instruction. Served exactly as returned; no wrapper removal.
Sparse rectangular platforms, five red gems and one lower-right exit do not match the demonstrated multilevel layout and paired upper-left exits.
Fireboy ArrowRight moves. Standard lowercase d does not move Watergirl; uppercase D does.
Characters remain suspended at y=300 with no input. A brief jump continues upward after release; Fireboy reaches y=-3 and visible loss.
No reference-like elemental pool encounter exercised. Upward boundary loss is not evidence of elemental hazard rules.
No normal route to cooperative interactions established; submitted source uses static platform objects and does not update switch activation.
No pickups exercised; all five generated gems remain during automatic victory.
R leaves positions and victory unchanged. Button restores moved Fireboy to initial position and hides victory, but displayed timer does not reset to zero.
With no player input after reload, visible You Win appears at displayed Time:48.5s. Characters remain at initial positions with five gems remaining.

sourceDiagnosis.timedVictory: updateGame advances through supplied frameTimes by elapsed time and declares victory when the final index is reached.
sourceDiagnosis.jump: While jumping, y decreases by a fixed amount each frame; no downward gravity phase.
sourceDiagnosis.controls: Keyboard lookup uses uppercase A/D/W and exact e.key matches.
sourceDiagnosis.restart: No R key handler; initGame sets lastTime=0, causing the next update to count elapsed page time again.

limits: Single attempt, no repairs or feedback.
No legitimate full playthrough established; automatic victory is not counted as success.
